title: Yelp Advertising 101: How to Find Success with Yelp Ads | LocaliQ

facts.fact: Any business can advertise on Yelp, and there is no minimum budget or minimum number of reviews required to start a campaign (per LocaliQ's description).
facts.quote: Any business can advertise on Yelp, as there is no minimum budget or minimum number of reviews needed to start a campaign.

facts.fact: You can start and stop Yelp ads at any time, according to LocaliQ.
facts.quote: You can start and stop your Yelp ads at any time

facts.fact: LocaliQ cites a third-party source (invespcro.com) stating that a one-star increase on Yelp can increase a business's revenue by up to 9%.
facts.quote: A one-star increase on Yelp can increase a business’s revenue by up to 9%.

facts.fact: Yelp ads appear in the 'Sponsored Results' sections above and below organic Yelp search results and also show on competitor pages.
facts.quote: Yelp ads appear in the “Sponsored Results” sections above and below organic Yelp search results, and they also show on competitor pages.

facts.fact: Claiming a Yelp profile unlocks additional Yelp ads features, such as the 'Request a Quote' option, according to LocaliQ.
facts.quote: claiming your profile on Yelp will unlock more Yelp ads features, like the “Request a Quote” option

facts.fact: This LocaliQ article was last updated on January 13, 2025.
